app.name: Family Timeline
app.tagline: A living history of your family

landing.pitch: One private place for your family tree, old photographs, and the stories behind them — built together, kept for the next generations.
landing.inviteOnlyNote: Family Timeline is invite-only. You join by receiving an invitation link from a family member, or by starting a new family yourself.

auth.registerSubtitle: Start your family's timeline or join one you were invited to.
auth.forgotSubtitle: We will email you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetLinkSent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.
auth.verifyBody: We sent you a verification link. Open it to activate your account.
auth.verifyBodyWithEmail: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.
auth.verifyHint: No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder.

errors.resetFailed: We could not update the password. The link may have expired.
errors.callbackFailed: Signing in did not complete. Please try again.

onboarding.step1Subtitle: Give your family a name and tell us who you are. You can invite everyone else in a moment.
onboarding.step2Subtitle: Add the people closest to you — parents, partner, siblings, children. Profiles can be claimed by them later.
